units.result: record [5.87, 50.0]  reader [5.87, 50.02]  2 km  ok  note: Hatched (German) XX box numbered 26, north east of Bastogne. A separate open box numbered 26 near 5.95E 49.88N is the US 26th Infantry Division, not this unit.
record [5.99, 49.87]  reader [5.89, 49.72]  18 km  DIFFERS  note: XXX corps headquarters box marked III with flag staff, near Arlon. Small III labels on the corps boundary ticks were not used.

readerNotes.line: North end where the heavy line comes down near the Maas at about 5.84E; Westwall hatching near Aachen not used. Bastogne is a salient open to the south. The south east end leaves the east edge near Saarlautern; a heavy line running south from there toward Metz looks like a boundary and was not followed. Line thinned to 38 points.
